title: Very cheaply made
text: Very cheaply made. Very small print pamphlet with instructions and hard to find that it wasn't top shelf dishwasher safe, so after one washing it is garbage. We also didn't like how it sprayed water everywhere when it was spinning / washing the vegetables. Not worth it.
